verdict.comment: Course winner WAL BUCK'S looked better than ever in a visor when a wide-margin scorer at Kelso recently and is hard to side against.

comments.ironbridge: Last win came here back in 2022 and he's not proving easy to catch right either
comments.kiwoo: Very good second at Doncaster but pulled up there since; he needs to bounce back
comments.maximilian: Failed to win in four small-field events this term; first run beyond 3m with more needed
comments.safedestination: Rare poor effort when pulled up at Fakenham latest; cheekpieces on and sort to bounce back
comments.walbucks: Course winner; visored for Kelso win latest; up 4lb but big shout with headgear retained

verdict.comment: Nothing to choose between these two at the weights but RUBY ISLAND is the better jumper.

comments.gamestersguy: Every chance but if it comes down to jumping he's second best; tongue-tie added
comments.rubyisland: Every chance and if it comes down to jumping she's the one to be on

verdict.comment: The vast majority of these have a question to answer which leaves HEATHER HONEY (nap) as the clear solid option.

comments.dalyboy: Fair effort on hurdles debut; downhill since but maybe wind surgery will help; h'cap debut
comments.freshersweek: Two good efforts on sound surface; up in trip for h'cap debut and drying ground will help
comments.harddealt: Consistency an issue this term but stamina in the family and step up in trip should suit
comments.heardthat: Out of sorts over fences this term and the return to hurdles needs to turn his ship around
comments.heatherhoney: Resumed progress with convincing win in November; solid since and looks the safe option
comments.inflexible: Last seen falling over fences 504 days ago; market helpful back over hurdles for new yard
comments.outerbanks: Won h'cap debut one year ago; poor comeback last month; wind surgery/cheekpieces may help
comments.spitspot: Didn't handle rise in grade in November but previously went back-to-back; chance if ready
comments.spitalfield: Mark fine but hurdling often holds him back and tailed off all three starts since January

verdict.comment: Solid Performer and Ballyeaston are big players but have differing queries over them so it may pay to side with CHEMOULIN.

comments.ballyeaston: Leading contender despite looking almost unrideable when 2nd last time; tongue-tie goes on
comments.chemoulin: Displayed ability in both starts and should make his presence felt in this winnable race
comments.coumeenoole: Little to shout about in three runs for Dan Skelton but this represents a drop in grade
comments.jonzac: 25,000euros buy after Irish point win but no show in three qualifying runs over hurdles
comments.nobledon: Beaten 17l in sole bumper in early 2024 and absent since; hurdles debut and bit to prove
comments.shuilewarrior: Won Chaddesley Corbett maiden in April but three starts under rules have been modest
comments.solidperformer: Placed in 3 maidens this term, latest at 3m1f; drop in trip not ideal but still a player
comments.yorkshiremansam: Beaten 50l in two starts this term and needs to prove he retains ability

verdict.comment: Handicap debutants The Cistercian (second choice) and Is This For Real hold leading claims but KING ULANDA gets the vote.

comments.dreamdiamond: 2m maiden win in August; flopped in 2m4f h'cap next month; drops back in trip for comeback
comments.goldwyn: Signed off for last yard after some poor efforts; makes stable debut after 397 days away
comments.isthisforreal: Won maiden seven weeks ago; up in trip and carries plenty of potential into handicap debut
comments.kingulanda: Impressed on return and good form since; step up in trip can unlock more; big player
comments.marlacoo: Expensive to follow since winning a maiden and moderate effort latest; others preferred
comments.mistralmilly: Often hinted she was capable of better for Emma Lavelle; yard debut after 504-day absence
comments.notnowlinda: In good form spring of 2024; low-key runs following absence but back to last winning mark
comments.phineasbunce: Hasn't built on solid start over hurdles and no promise when beaten 21l on handicap debut
comments.princeimperial: Yet to get going for this yard and was pulled up on his last two starts, latterly at 200-1
comments.static: Yet to score in ten starts in Britain but drops back down in grade from a falling mark
comments.sunrayshadow: Hasn't built on 2024 maiden (2m4f, good) win; drops back in trip with cheekpieces fitted
comments.thecistercian: Good efforts in three of four goes for this yard; player back up in trip on handicap debut
comments.theegyptianginge: Looked a work in progress over hurdles; step up in trip should help on this handicap debut

verdict.comment: Tom Lacey's LAND OF PUNT took a good step forward when at Plumpton and is taken to make a winning handicap debut.

comments.beepbeepbecky: Showed no improvement at Catterick yesterday on handicap debut
comments.berkenshtaaap: Struggled in good-quality maiden in November but first two hurdle runs were encouraging
comments.fastwork: Shade disappointing over C&D last time but was placed on handicap debut at Wetherby
comments.idahovalley: Only third when odds-on for modest maiden last month and now 0-8 over hurdles
comments.jeholdethaix: Shaped quite well on seasonal/handicap debut in October but not seen since
comments.landofpunt: Improved form when third in Plumpton novice in January; can progress again in handicaps
comments.lheurdegloire: Safely held in three 2m novice hurdles this season but has faced some useful opposition
comments.northmoon: Showed only minor promise in Ireland; pulled up in a point on British debut
comments.stungbytariffs: Struggled on heavy ground two starts ago but other two qualifying runs were encouraging
comments.thegreatescape: Second on last summer's handicap debut; ended 2025 with two lesser efforts

verdict.comment: An interesting event with a few to consider but LOCKER BOUM's Irish point form got a right boost in an Ayr bumper in January.

comments.executiveproducer: Ran his race back to front when 18-1 and tailed off in December; added hood might help
comments.fullythermal: 28-1 and weakened to finish tenth of 15 at Wetherby (soft) in December
comments.hurlyburly: Stepped up when sixth of 15 at Wetherby last time; probably capable of better again
comments.lockerboum: Won his second Irish point and that form has been boosted under rules; interesting
comments.marblesky: 125-1 when tailed off in Wetherby bumper (soft) in December
comments.nightflyer: £95,000 buy after a winning debut (soft) in January; leading contender under the penalty
comments.oldclayesmorian: Won on debut and solid fourth in valuable event next time; respected under the penalty
comments.orderdriven: By Order Of St George; yard can have winning newcomers; market check essential
comments.oykelbridge: 9l third to Old Clayesmorian in December bumper; 7lb weight pull can bring them closer
comments.turbocharged: Third behind a good one in November; respected despite 119-day break and wind surgery

verdict.comment: If this race is run as much to suit as Kempton last time, LADY MAGIC may be able to double up. Indannya heads the alternatives.

comments.chattygirl: Present optimum trip not established; more needed, and maybe one for handicaps instead.
comments.dunadenisland: Majorly outran her 125-1 odds on C&D hurdling debut; likely far better ground awaits.
comments.fountainsgala: From smart jumping family but no immediate promise on January's bumper debut, beaten 48l.
comments.indannya: Warwick 2m5f winner before too big an ask in a Grade 2; untried over shorter than 2m3f.
comments.kapability: Mostly fairly highly tried following bumper win; no better for drop back in class latest.
comments.kaydence: Nature of Uttoxeter bumper win two starts ago suggested she may want further over hurdles.
comments.lacadalora: Placed in seven of eight mainly middle-distance Flat starts; in good hands for hurdling.
comments.ladymagic: Over 4l too good for pace-setting Our Peggy in Kempton win latest (2m); player again.
comments.misscarbo: Fair second on British debut at Warwick (2m, good to soft), but two backwards steps since.
comments.ourpeggy: Gave Lady Magic nice tow into the race at Kempton latest; may progress if settling better.
comments.sevarana: Brave Carlisle winner latest (2m3f, good to soft); drop back in trip likely not a plus.
comments.sveltesilhouette: C&D bumper third in November (good), but jumping has been an issue on both hurdles starts.
comments.tonislegacy: Beat few home in light Flat career; some very useful hurdling types hidden in pedigree.

verdict.comment: Drying ground and attractive marks refresh the appeal of both STANS THE MAN and Get Up Mush, preferred in that order.

comments.bataillon: Win and (latest) second over Taunton's 2m7f latterly; up 3lb but can remain competitive.
comments.getupmush: Spared slow ground for the first time since his comeback; last win came off 3lb higher.
comments.gyenyame: Chance on November's Exeter 0-130 second (3m, good), with excuses either side of that.
comments.hipopdesongrais: Suited by trip and any drying ground; offered little on sole start since November 2023.
comments.ignorethedoor: Staying chaser on pedigree but offered insufficient switched to fences latest; down 2lb.
comments.kilbarryhill: Jumping issues on his two most recent chase starts, but trip, ground and mark all fine.
comments.stanstheman: Mixed bag since the autumn, but now back on a winning mark; dryout has come in time.
comments.thefamousfive: Back on a winning mark but couldn't be certain he'll capitalise, especially up in trip.
comments.tommythetank: Jumping didn't hold up on December's chasing debut; has since received wind operation.

verdict.comment: Although up 5lb, it takes little to imagine TOUQUET boss this small field, with old rival A Great Excuse set to run him closest.

comments.agreatexcuse: Player on form of December's Lingfield win (2m, good to soft); didn't see out 2m3f latest.
comments.haasboy: Chase and hurdle winner this term, with stronger form over the latter; eased 3lb.
comments.sagegreen: No major uplift since wind surgery and addition of tongue tie; chasers in the pedigree.
comments.touquet: 2-2 at Huntingdon (2m) since the tongue tie went on; latest 5lb rise appears fair.

verdict.comment: Preference is for CROSSGALES KING, who ran well in defeat over C&D last month. Dr Seb is feared most.

comments.alanbresil: Safely held on handicap debut (2m7f) and struggled in a subsequent maiden (2m4f)
comments.crossgalesking: 0-5 over hurdles but was clear second to progressive rival over C&D last month
comments.drseb: Absent since ready win on handicap debut in summer 2024 but still looks very interesting
comments.itsabreeze: 0-7 over hurdles but Paul Nicholls may yet find the key to him
comments.jacksprat: Good second on seasonal debut but looked out of sorts on both runs since (hurdle/chase)
comments.octoberhill: Good third in 2m3f Taunton maiden in January but safely held in a handicap last month
comments.springtimelegend: Made all on heavy ground last month; still low mileage but moves back up in grade
comments.teorie: Well below best on soft/heavy ground in recent months but drying ground offers hope
comments.tractorjack: Pulled up when upped to 2m4f for handicap debut but remains very unexposed

verdict.comment: Recent Hereford third PENN AVENUE may still have potential over hurdles and ought to be suited by the drying ground here.

comments.daany: Ran well to a point on heavy ground on last two outings; worth a second look
comments.dreamska: Placed on hurdle debut but yet to build on that run; overlooked by Harry Skelton
comments.frankstamper: Low-mileage 4yo who stayed on well for second at Plumpton recently; respected
comments.pennavenue: Clear third off this mark at Hereford recently and the better ground here will suit
comments.perfectnelson: Well beaten last month but that run was on heavy ground and after a long layoff
comments.princerhinegold: Just 1-17 over hurdles but ended 2025 with two good C&D runs in cheekpieces
comments.rafflesnobu: 0-5 for new stable this season but his Lingfield fourth in January was a good effort
comments.sonoftyran: Showed no promise in novice/maiden hurdles but open to improvement in handicaps
comments.thankyouandplease: Ran quite well over 2m5f here last month and may benefit from this drop back in trip
comments.tyson: Has not shown much for new stable (three runs) but can't be written off yet
comments.ugobingo: Well beaten over 2m5f here recently but a player if judged on previous C&D form
comments.westernsoldier: Has excuses for both defeats since C&D win in November but others appeal more all the same

verdict.comment: Dan Horsford's THE LIGHTMAKER was second in what is turning out to be a good Chepstow race in December and he looks he one to beat.

comments.hessomething: Stayed on for respectable sixth on debut at Exeter but needs to take a step forward here
comments.keepoffthesugar: Not beaten far when fifth over C&D last March; booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye
comments.lecoldgrey: Displayed clear promise when close third of six on Lingfield AW in January; shortlisted
comments.lookdontstare: Always behind over C&D (good) on debut in November
comments.mariniere: Beaten about 22l when fifth of six at Newton Abbot last June; now with new stable
comments.nevadasamba: Newcomer; has the right type of pedigree and stable has good bumper strike-rate
comments.octogane: Only fourth when warm favourite for debut in spring 2024; makes belated reappearance here
comments.oscarjack: Second foal from a low-grade 2m5f/3m hurdle winner; best watched on debut
comments.rineyeats: Bought for £55,000 after winning Irish point by 6l in November; rules debut today
comments.saintinvictus: Launched rules career with two encouraging runs towards end of last year
comments.sixfourgold: Out of a bumper-winning high-sister to high-class chaser God's Own; appeals on paper
comments.thelightmaker: Kept on for second at Chepstow in December and sets a good standard of rules form
comments.tripleedge: First foal from a hurdle/chase winner; good market support will make him of interest
comments.valiantsoldier: Made quite promising debut when fifth on heavy ground here; now needs to build on that

verdict.comment: This can go to BALLYMACKIE (nap), who started off for Olly Murphy with two wins and could still have more improvement to come.

comments.anotherfolly: Made all at Stratford in October and has performed well off this mark twice since
comments.ballymackie: Low-mileage 8yo who is 2-2 for new stable this season; commands respect
comments.duhallowtommy: Showed benefit of wind op when clear winner at Southwell last month; likely contender
comments.palamon: Well handicapped on old form but safely held on all three starts for Dan Skelton this year
comments.pilsdonpen: Has suffered  slump in form since his C&D win in December and has questions to answer
comments.royalmer: Six chase wins, the latest on heavy going here last month; drier ground not ideal today

verdict.comment: Fidelius arrives in top form but THE THAMES BOATMAN (nap) may be the one to be with this time.

comments.fidelius: C&D win last month was followed by a near-miss at Chelmsford; back down in class today
comments.lequinto: Good 2nd here in January but not so good twice since; no AW win since December 2021
comments.levelup: Stiff task from 5lb out of the handicap; could get the lead though and conditions are fine
comments.thethamesboatman: Conditions to suit and he has had excuses in two runs since January's C&D win; contender
comments.toolatetonegotiate: Conditions ideal and didn't have the run of the race here last time; still on the upgrade

verdict.comment: Folk Pageant is the one to beat but she's been off since July and AL MASLOOL could be the answer with his debut effort behind him.

comments.almaslool: Promise amidst inexperience over C&D 12 days ago; could prove a different proposition here
comments.constantstar: 55,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to an AW winner out of an AW winner; check betting
comments.floatingmarket: Dam a well-related winner (1m to 2m); one of two newcomers for connections; betting useful
comments.folkpageant: Second to subsequent Group 3 winner on debut last July; sets standard and can do better
comments.goldfinder: Modest form in two 1m Polytrack maidens this year; handicaps more suitable after this
comments.lakotachief: Green on debut but failed to build on it a month later (both Newcastle; 7f/1m); needs more
comments.pureisking: Bumper winner on debut before two lesser runs; sharp 1m a query on Flat debut
comments.thundergoddess: Her four siblings have all been successful but middle distances will suit better in time

verdict.comment: The early skirmishes will be crucial and MICK'S SPIRIT is marginally preferred to last week's runaway winner Beaumadier.

comments.beaumadier: Dominated a 5f handicap at Wolverhampton last week; better drawn here; 3lb well in; solid
comments.diamonddreamer: On a good mark and this could set up for him but others appeal more all the same
comments.gogoyubari: Had a fine winter but the handicapper may have caught up with her now
comments.helloluna: Good C&D run in January but less good at Chelmsford last time; now steps up in class
comments.micksspirit: Beat two of these opponents over C&D in January; less good twice since; can't rule out

verdict.comment: Stephanie Cassidy's C&D scorer SO CHIC could prove the answer here having hinted at a revival when fifth at Wolverhampton last time out

comments.backbeforedark: Ended her time with Grant Tuer below par and last for new yard over C&D eight days ago
comments.daddychill: Unseated rider early having hung left here three weeks ago; has something to prove now
comments.danehillstar: Caught wide when C&D fifth latest; this course winner is a likely player off same mark
comments.pinksocks: Beat one at Wolverhampton last run for Ian Williams; needs yard move to spark resurgence
comments.pottersprince: Good fifth at Chelmsford latest, despite hanging left; he needs to build on it now
comments.secretroad: Signed off for James Owen with solid Southwell sixth; not ruled out for new stable here
comments.sochic: C&D winner; hinted at revival with Wolverhampton fifth latest; can go very well now
comments.villalobos: Good fourth at Kempton 45 days ago; this C&D scorer merits serious consideration eased 1lb

verdict.comment: Dandy Khan and Age Of Time should be in the thick of it but PROFIT STREET can record his third C&D win of the year.

comments.ageoftime: Close up in his last three races; sharp 7f a slight query but not on a bad mark
comments.dakotapower: Drops in class today but others arrive in better form
comments.dandykhan: Five course wins this winter; penalty for Saturday's snug success; looks a key player
comments.francisco: Slow starter who can pull too hard; in fair form but comes with risk attached
comments.poeticforce: 18th win of his long career at Wolverhampton last month; form franked; new headgear today
comments.profitstreet: Strong form for the grade last month, winning twice over C&D; 5lb well in under penalty

verdict.comment: Montu and Private Project can do better yet but BRADBURY appeals as a likely improver and he can make a winning handicap debut.

comments.akrivos: 3l behind Montu when fourth at Wolverhampton 10 days ago; up in trip and needs more for it
comments.bergamogold: Best effort so far when 2nd at Chelmsford last month; up in trip and may do better for it
comments.bradbury: Down the field in three 7f novices last summer; likely improver upped in trip/handicapping
comments.chilliconcarneigh: Consistent but exposed at up to 8.6f; new trip needs to coax out a bit more from him
comments.montu: Strong at the finish when 2nd over 9.5f at Wolverhampton ten days ago; capable of better
comments.privateproject: Promising stable debut (7f) last week; likely to stay 1m2f and open to further progress
comments.sundaysinatra: Ran OK on penultimate start but failed to back it up one month later; others look safer

verdict.comment: Tony Carroll holds a strong hand and the return of headgear can see MASQOOL get the better of stablemate Galaxy Wonder.

comments.crafter: Conditions to suit, on a good mark and Billy Loughnane back on board; big run expected
comments.eutropia: 0-13 but third on her last three starts, the latest over C&D; should remain competitive
comments.galaxywonder: String of good runs for new yard this winter; set to go well again
comments.keeperofsecrets: Set to go close at Wolverhampton ten days ago but met trouble; still has low mileage
comments.masqool: Multiple C&D winner; two solid efforts for Tony Carroll and headgear returns today

verdict.comment: Last year's winner NIKOVO (nap) signalled he is ready to go in again when a promising Kempton third in a race not run to suit.

comments.aislingoscar: Eighth win on spin at Southwell last month; seventh there latest but can't be ruled out
comments.doctorkhanjunior: Gamely scored at Southwell latest; up 3lb but this C&D winner can go very well again
comments.eldrickjones: Gained fourth C&D win in December and he's continued in good nick; ought to be thereabouts
comments.grandtraverse: Signed off for Archie Watson with solid sixth at Kempton; can't be discounted for new yard
comments.nikovo: Took this a year ago; promising third at Kempton eight days ago; big shout off same mark
comments.persuasion: Beat one in 7f Leicester handicap in October; needs to hit ground running on his comeback
comments.sunriseontheboyne: Rusty after five months off when C&D ninth on yard debut 27 days ago; can build on it
comments.talisevolvere: Below-par fifth over 7f at Southwell latest; this course winner needs to bounce back

verdict.comment: The looks a golden opportunity for BILLECART who showed plenty of promise when fourth on his Newmarket debut last July.

comments.billecart: Fourth of 12 in a red-hot Newmarket maiden last July; has been found a golden opportunity
comments.shimmeringspirit: Didn't run badly when fourth on his debut here a fortnight ago, but unlikely to win this
comments.toodarnspicy: Market should indicate what is expected on debut
comments.wuood: Faces a useful rival in Billecart, but still interesting to see what the market says

verdict.comment: Stephen Hanlon's ESQUE ELEGANCE is taken to build on her very good recent C&D second (form been franked) and gain her first win.

comments.esqueelegance: Still to get head in front but in very good form, C&D runner-up latest; leading claims
comments.fuelthefire: Below-par sixth here back in August; returns from seven months off with lots to find
comments.ladydelila: Is 0-15 but back on track with Wolverhampton third 34 days ago; she's one to consider
comments.martinsbrig: Three-time C&D scorer but arrives out of sorts; needs headgear change to spark resurgence
comments.sirmaxi: On long losing run but good C&D third latest; this dual course winner enters calculations
comments.starshot: Solid fourth of ten in classified event over C&D 18 days ago so he's in the mix again
comments.topguntina: Only sixth of ten in classified event over C&D 40 days ago; others are much preferred
comments.wheresthecrumpet: C&D winner; good third of at Southwell 60 days ago; can make her presence felt
comments.woodrafff: Not seen to ideal effect when fourth at Southwell nine days ago; likely player once more

verdict.comment: Tthe vote goes to the lightly raced and consistent 5yo MONTY BEAU, who may still be capable of better.

comments.anaemaraaty: Five-time winner here; capable of playing a part if this sets up for his closing style
comments.bearwith: Dual C&D winner including last month; respected, especially if getting a good pace
comments.bintkend: Has shown ability; this stiffer test should suit on handicap debut and makes the shortlist
comments.boubyan: Placed once in eight starts for this yard and yet to prove his stamina over this far
comments.haveyoumissedme: Just 1lb above last winning mark, but recent efforts suggest he needs a return to further
comments.imperialtrooper: Second of 11 over C&D in January; each-way claims if reproducing that effort off 1lb lower
comments.lighteningcompany: Has gone well over 1m here but all three efforts over C&D since October have been blowouts
comments.maoshangwong: 0-6; beaten just over a length behind Bearwith over C&D last month and 3lb better off
comments.minersgamble: Form since returning in December has been patchy and is just 1-23
comments.montybeau: Lightly raced 5yo who has proved consistent so far; may still have more to offer
comments.natzor: Dual C&D winner, but has lost his way for this yard including three poor efforts back here

verdict.comment: Lots with chances but LION'S HOUSE looked unlucky not to add to a recent C&D win when third at Wolverhampton and can gain compensation.

comments.albegone: Bounced back to form with C&D second last month; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb
comments.blueforce: Dual C&D winner; free-going fifth at Southwell latest; can make presence felt back at 5f
comments.castan: Took this in 2024 and runner-up over C&D latest; he can go well again off the same mark
comments.darkkestrel: Not at all discredited when close eighth here two weeks ago; needs considering
comments.digital: Narrowly denied fourth C&D success two weeks ago; up 2lb but he's not taken lightly
comments.harb: Capitalised on a reduced mark when scoring over C&D latest; back up 3lb but well in mix
comments.juanlespins: In good form until tenth at Southwell 13 days ago; handily weighted if back on his A-game
comments.lionshouse: C&D winner and unlucky not to follow up at Wolverhampton, twice denied clear run; player
comments.moonstoneboy: Too free over 6f when seventh at Wolverhampton latest; can bounce back here
comments.ourabsentfriends: Gained a third C&D success in December and largely in good nick since; in the shake-up
comments.popstar: Yet to hit top form for new yard, last of nine over C&D two weeks ago; others preferred
comments.waterofleith: Second for fourth time in 2026 at Wolverhampton latest; he's firmly in the picture again

verdict.comment: The choice is ARISHKA'S DREAM who has winning form at Wolverhampton and is 2lb well in following his narrow defeat on handicap debut.

comments.arishkasdream: Wolverhampton winner and beaten a head on handicap debut at Lingfield; 2lb well in
comments.elizabetty: Has finished first and third here the last twice, but has a bit to prove back over 6f
comments.esponabay: Second in all three starts on the AW for Michael Bell; may again find one or two too good
comments.filleunique: Showed ability in first three starts, but has a bit to prove up in trip after 103 days off
comments.linacodina: Moderate form in five starts and a transformation is required on stable debut; blinkers on
comments.marradonna: Beaten less than a length in two Tapeta nurseries last month; this stiff 6f might suit him
comments.mightyvega: Fair efforts in handicaps since winning a Kempton novice, but needs more on stable debut
comments.moretons: Just beaten at Wolverhampton in October, but twice held since; more needed on stable debut
comments.pivotalterms: Finished around 5l behind Marra Donna on stable debut at Wolverhampton last month
comments.sparklingpink: Won a Pontefract nursery last July, but held in all three subsequent starts; off 164 days
comments.tacticalblitz: Proressive in three starts in January; gelded since; respected now switched to a handicap

verdict.comment: Archie Watson's KINGOFTHECARNIVAL brings a fair bit of potential and is taken to emerge on top now starting out in handicap company.

comments.archangeljosepi: Back on track when third here 19 days ago; very much one to consider off 2lb lower mark
comments.dreamforever: Much-improved second here 23 days ago; likely player up 1lb with 7f promising to suit
comments.kingofthecarnival: Progressive sort at 2yrs; gelded and better to come on his handicap debut; interesting
comments.laserluck: Beat only one on yard/handicap debut at Lingfield 12 days ago; lots more is needed here
comments.maximumvelocity: Cut little ice in three runs at 2yrs; can step forward now h'capping up markedly in trip
comments.meresideprincess: Good Southwell third on New Year's Day; can go well in her bid for a maiden success
comments.pantherenoir: 0-8 and needs a gelding operation to spark improvement if he's to get off the mark
comments.poptyping: Good second of eight over 7f here 19 days ago; she must enter calculations eased 1lb
comments.populus: Failed to build on earlier promise with C&D sixth latest; could still do better in h'caps
comments.ravensview: Brought along steadily, sixth in 6f novice here latest; open to progress on handicap debut
comments.sirhana: Remote fourth of eight on h'cap debut at Wolverhampton 20 days ago; lots more is required
comments.southcoaststar: Failed to improve on h'cap debut when well-held Wolverhampton third latest; more required
